description:
The legendary Blood Magic Book of the Blood Demon Sect...! The martial arts world is stained with blood over the Blood Magic Book. The Dansimryeon Yeonju dreams of reigning over the martial arts world, and he must be stopped. The one who will dominate the martial arts world in chaos! Who is he? The lustful demon Lee Gun-Ak who must save the martial arts world from the bloody storm that is raging.

 *“Ugh! My home the other day was Cheonghwaru, yesterday was Samyogak, and today it’s Banwolgwan. All the Giru are my home, so stop telling me to go home with that nonsense.”*

Will he be able to stop the bloody storm?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
